# Adwaita icons

These icons come from [Adwaita Icon Theme 50.0][adwaita], by the [GNOME Project][gnome]. They use
[Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 United States][license]. The `LICENSE` file contains
the license. The source paths use the same geometry as the Linux app's system icons, with line
wrapping for this repository. `build-icons.sh` renders them at Android's display densities.

[adwaita]: https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/adwaita-icon-theme/-/tree/50.0
[gnome]: https://www.gnome.org
[license]: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/us/
